name: comp-369
blurb: Dropdown menu with grouped items and dividers.
description: A dropdown with DropdownMenuGroup and DropdownMenuSeparator for organizing items into logical sections, including a destructive delete action.
use_when: Menu items fall into logical groups and need visual separation.
avoid_when: Simple flat menus or when grouping adds confusion.
a11y: Groups are semantic; separators are visual.
